GlobalScore.title: GlobalScore
GlobalScore.description: Personal best global leaderboard entry for an authenticated player.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who achieved the score.

displayName.description: Sanitized public leaderboard display name (no PII or email).

score.description: Player's highest stacked tower score (positive integer).

maxCombo.description: Highest perfect-drop streak achieved on the best score run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player first posted to the global leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player last beat their personal best.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: International user account, 6-digit referral code, invite counter, USD balance (in cents), collectible game coins, and 24-hour daily sign-in reward tracker.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified Google account email address (PII restricted to owner and admin).

myCode.description: Unique 6-digit numeric referral code generated on signup.

invitesCount.description: Total number of verified new signups referred by myCode.

balance.description: Current withdrawable wallet balance in USD cents (5 = $0.05 daily bonus, 20 = $0.20 per invite).

coins.description: In-game Gold Coins earned from 3D block drops, coin pickups, daily bonuses, and referrals (500 Coins = $0.05 USD).

referredBy.description: 6-digit referral code used at signup, or empty string if organic.

lastDailyRewardAt.description: Server timestamp when the user last claimed their 24-hour daily sign-in bonus.

savedPayoutMethod.description: User's saved preferred payout method so they do not have to re-enter it on every withdrawal.

savedPayoutAccount.description: User's saved preferred payout account ID, email, wallet address, or mobile wallet number (PII isolated to owner and admin).

savedPayoutName.description: User's saved preferred payout account holder full name.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest wallet or profile update.

ReferralCode.title: ReferralCode
ReferralCode.description: Public non-PII lookup record mapping a 6-digit referral code to its owner UID.

ownerUid.description: UID of the user who owns this referral code.

ownerName.description: Sanitized public name of the referrer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was registered.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Immutable record of an invited friend credited to a referrer in USD cents and Gold Coins.

invitedUid.description: UID of the newly signed-up friend (matches document ID).

invitedName.description: Sanitized public display name of the invited friend.

referrerUid.description: UID of the referrer receiving +1 invite, +$0.20 (20 cents), and +100 Coins.

rewardCents.description: Fixed referral reward in USD cents (20 = $0.20).

rewardCoins.description: Fixed referral bonus in Gold Coins (100 Coins).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the referral was completed.

WithdrawRequest.title: WithdrawRequest
WithdrawRequest.description: International USD payout request via RedotPay, Binance Pay, USDT (TRC20), or PayPal once invitesCount >= 50.

requestId.description: Document ID of the withdraw request.

email.description: Verified email of the requesting user (visible only to owner and admin).

invitesCount.description: Verified invites count at time of withdrawal (must be >= 50).

amount.description: Requested payout amount in USD cents.

paymentMethod.description: International payout rail selected by user (RedotPay, BinancePay, USDT_TRC20, PayPal, or legacy mobile wallets).

accountNumber.description: RedotPay/Binance Pay UID or email, TRC20 wallet address, or PayPal email.

status.description: Review state of the payout request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when withdrawal was requested.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest status update.

/globalScores/{userId}.description: Global Top 100 leaderboard storing one personal-best score document per authenticated user.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user account, USD wallet balance (cents), Gold Coins, and 24h daily reward timestamp isolated to owner and admin.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Public non-PII 6-digit referral code lookup mapping code to ownerUid.

/referrals/{invitedUid}.description: Immutable invited-friends ledger keyed by invitedUid.

/withdrawRequests/{requestId}.description: International USD payout requests via RedotPay, Binance Pay, USDT (TRC20), or PayPal for users with >= 50 invites.
